title: Building the Cantor set
caption: Each stage removes the middle third of every piece left, so the length kept is 1, 2/3, 4/9, …, (2/3)ⁿ → 0. The lengths removed, 1/3 + 2/9 + 4/27 + …, add up to 1, so the Cantor set has measure 0.
alt: Three bars of equal length. Stage 0 is a whole bar. Stage 1 keeps the outer thirds and removes the middle third. Stage 2 keeps four pieces of length 1/9 and removes the gaps between them.
description: Stage 0 is the whole interval [0, 1], length 1.
Stage 1 removes the middle third (length 1/3), keeping two pieces of 1/3: total 2/3.
Stage 2 removes the middle ninth of each piece (2 × 1/9 = 2/9), keeping four pieces of 1/9: total 4/9.
After n stages the length kept is (2/3)ⁿ, which tends to 0: the removed lengths sum to 1.
